title: Sargon II stays in the land to rebuild his army
summary: The Eponym Chronicle records no campaign for 712 BC: “the king stayed in the land.”
description: The Eponym Chronicle records no campaign for 712 BC: “the king stayed in the land.” Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 3, rows 712–711, p. 45; Table 2, row 712, p. 41).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 712 BC (Sargon year 10).

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 3, rows 712–711, p. 45; Table 2, row 712, p. 41
chronologies.note: Eponym Chronicle: “The King stayed in the land”. The authors read it as rebuilding the army after the loss of 185,000; 711 BC was “probably” a second such year.
